_note: GENERATED by `npm run pens`. The four inside corners of each pen's ground quad, in SPRITE-LOCAL pixels relative to the frame rect. A pen is a rectangle on the ground plane in perspective, so "inside" is a quadrilateral: `far` is the back corner, `near` the front, `left` and `right` the sides. Stand an animal by interpolating its footY between the far and near edges, and give the near rail a z-index of the front edge so an animal at the back draws behind it.
_detectionNote: Detected by flooding the interior fill from the sprite centre and taking the four extreme points, which ARE the corners because the quad is diamond-oriented in this projection. Nothing is hand-typed, so nothing goes stale when a pen is regenerated.
_footLineNote: footLine is the lowest opaque row of the whole sprite — where the near fence meets the ground. Place the pen by its foot line, not its top.
